natural_language_statement: Lean verifies fixed two-state rule equations, an unlabelled13-row adjacent-edge cancellation with a cofinal pumping/lower-bound contradiction, an8-row labeled-symbol cancellation, and a50-row labeled-edge cancellation. Generic symbol/edge ordered-additive-group wrappers exclude orientations that make every dynamic rule strict and every auxiliary rule weak in that fixed algebra. Limitations: The unlabelled lower-bound conclusion has a genuine cofinality hypothesis. This does not formalize scalar-arctic full/top certificates, all70algebras, arbitrary labelings or general termination. The broader first-rule-removal support statement retains Python/prose status; it is not the generic Lean wrapper.
